answer_1.quote: Abstractive summarization focuses on generating fluent and concise text from the original input document

answer_2.quote: To evaluate summarization performance, we use the ROUGE metrics (R-1, R-2 and R-L)

answer_4.quote: To evaluate the abstractive ability of our method, we conduct a human evaluation on the two aspects of readability and non-redundancy.
answer_4.guideline: Readability measures how easy a text is to read, and depends on the elements of grammaticality and coherence. Non-redundancy mainly denotes the degree of linguistic brevity of a text in conveying the main idea.
